title: Banor What Can I Do Boss

nodes.speaker: Banor
nodes.text: Carrying some troubles today, eh boss? Can't say I'm much doing better.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Carrying some troubles today, eh boss? Can't say I'm much doing better.

nodes.speaker: Banor
nodes.text: Thanks for asking boss, but I've been through this rodeo before. Same old same old. I just concentrate on keeping the grease traps clean.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thanks for asking boss, but I've been through this rodeo before. Same old same old. I just concentrate on keeping the grease traps clean.

nodes.speaker: Banor
nodes.text: Yeah, I heard Mica has been harassing you again. She's a different breed from most of the Corpster's boss. You gotta be careful with that one.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah, I heard Mica has been harassing you again. She's a different breed from most of the Corpster's boss. You gotta be careful with that one.

nodes.speaker: Banor
nodes.text: As in she was just there waiting for you? What... what was she doing?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: As in she was just there waiting for you? What... what was she doing?

nodes.speaker: Banor
nodes.text: Umm. I'm sorry boss, I'm not sure how to respond to that. I mean, you do you, but while she's with Sec, that's a path you best not follow.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Umm. I'm sorry boss, I'm not sure how to respond to that. I mean, you do you, but while she's with Sec, that's a path you best not follow.

nodes.speaker: Banor
nodes.text: I'm scared of what she might have told you. How bad is it? Are we as dead as digital privacy?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm scared of what she might have told you. How bad is it? Are we as dead as digital privacy?

nodes.speaker: Banor
nodes.text: That doesn't seem like Ed. Not his style. I know he's dedicated to the cause and all, but not to the point of betraying allies.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That doesn't seem like Ed. Not his style. I know he's dedicated to the cause and all, but not to the point of betraying allies.

nodes.speaker: Banor
nodes.text: I know my seasonings. This was disguised well, but I can spot when something ain't right.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I know my seasonings. This was disguised well, but I can spot when something ain't right.

nodes.speaker: Banor
nodes.text: Of course! Here ya go, boss.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Of course! Here ya go, boss.

nodes.speaker: Banor
nodes.text: Oooof. Haven't seen that around in some time. Was a good drink though. Smooth as silicon. Why ya askin'?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oooof. Haven't seen that around in some time. Was a good drink though. Smooth as silicon. Why ya askin'?

nodes.speaker: Banor
nodes.text: Not a problem boss. I hope this straightens itself out. This stuff was hidden well. No one would spot it unless they knew what to look for.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not a problem boss. I hope this straightens itself out. This stuff was hidden well. No one would spot it unless they knew what to look for.

nodes.speaker: Banor
nodes.text: Ah, gotcha. There's a vendor named Harmony who hangs out in Lowtown. You've probably met her. If it was anywhere, it'd be in that backpack of hers.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ah, gotcha. There's a vendor named Harmony who hangs out in Lowtown. You've probably met her. If it was anywhere, it'd be in that backpack of hers.

nodes.speaker: Banor
nodes.text: His whole network would come down if he screwed over the wrong person. Ain't worth the risk. Having said that...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: His whole network would come down if he screwed over the wrong person. Ain't worth the risk. Having said that...

nodes.speaker: Banor
nodes.text: The chicken came wrapped in Shimmer Sage. Sometimes they do this to hide the real age of the chickens. The smell, you know.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The chicken came wrapped in Shimmer Sage. Sometimes they do this to hide the real age of the chickens. The smell, you know.

nodes.speaker: Banor
nodes.text: Nope. That's the thing. Produce was fresh as a new Dolly song.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nope. That's the thing. Produce was fresh as a new Dolly song.

nodes.speaker: Banor
nodes.text: It was the sage though. Something was off about it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It was the sage though. Something was off about it.

nodes.speaker: Banor
nodes.text: When you compressed it between your fingers, the texture was wrong. Scent was wrong. It was genetically modified.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: When you compressed it between your fingers, the texture was wrong. Scent was wrong. It was genetically modified.

nodes.speaker: Banor
nodes.text: The pork came wrapped in Shimmer Sage. Sometimes they do this to hide the real age of the meat. The smell, you know.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The pork came wrapped in Shimmer Sage. Sometimes they do this to hide the real age of the meat. The smell, you know.

nodes.speaker: Banor
nodes.text: The onions came wrapped in Shimmer Sage. Sometimes they do this to hide their real age. The smell, you know.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: The onions came wrapped in Shimmer Sage. Sometimes they do this to hide their real age. The smell, you know.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How are you holding up after the raid by Mica Rain?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How are you holding up after the raid by Mica Rain?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: How are you holding up after the raid by Mica Rain?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: How are you holding up after the raid by Mica Rain?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I ran into Mica Rain again.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I ran into Mica Rain again.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I ran into Mica Rain again.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I ran into Mica Rain again.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I went home and Mica Rain was there waiting for me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I went home and Mica Rain was there waiting for me.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I went home and Mica Rain was there waiting for me.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I went home and Mica Rain was there waiting for me.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Need your help with something.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Need your help with something.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Need your help with something.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Need your help with something.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Doesn't matter. It's what she said.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Doesn't matter. It's what she said.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Doesn't matter. It's what she said.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Doesn't matter. It's what she said.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: She had a lot to say.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: She had a lot to say.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: She had a lot to say.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: She had a lot to say.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: She's cute though...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: She's cute though...
pronounText.TextSheVersion: She's cute though...
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: She's cute though...

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Truly a nightmare.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Truly a nightmare.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Truly a nightmare.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Truly a nightmare.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yeah?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Yeah?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Yeah?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Edison played us. That's what she said.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Edison played us. That's what she said.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Edison played us. That's what she said.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Edison played us. That's what she said.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How'd you figure out it wasn't really Shimmer Sage?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How'd you figure out it wasn't really Shimmer Sage?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: How'd you figure out it wasn't really Shimmer Sage?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: How'd you figure out it wasn't really Shimmer Sage?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Interesting. Let me have what's left.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Interesting. Let me have what's left.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Interesting. Let me have what's left.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Interesting. Let me have what's left.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Thanks, Banor. Good work.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thanks, Banor. Good work.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Thanks, Banor. Good work.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Thanks, Banor. Good work.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Alright... Do you know who carries Windowpane Lager?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Alright... Do you know who carries Windowpane Lager?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Alright... Do you know who carries Windowpane Lager?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Alright... Do you know who carries Windowpane Lager?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Friend wanted it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Friend wanted it.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Friend wanted it.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Friend wanted it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm going to meet Edison. Wanted to bring it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm going to meet Edison. Wanted to bring it.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm going to meet Edison. Wanted to bring it.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm going to meet Edison. Wanted to bring it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Thanks.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thanks.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Thanks.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Thanks.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You noticed something, right?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You noticed something, right?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You noticed something, right?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You noticed something, right?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So it was rotten?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So it was rotten?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So it was rotten?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So it was rotten?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's probably why they're so cheap.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's probably why they're so cheap.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: That's probably why they're so cheap.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: That's probably why they're so cheap.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What was it then?
